## 📄 Spec updated — tag identity now explicit

Reusing a tag name always refers to one shared tag, never a duplicate. Added in three places:

- **US3, acceptance scenario 4** — applying an existing tag name to another bookmark refers to the same single tag; both bookmarks share one tag identity.
- **FR-008a** — each tag name is a single shared tag across the collection; reuse refers to that same tag and never creates a duplicate, so rename/delete, `#tag` search, and click-to-filter all act on one consistent identity.
- **Tag entity** — "Each tag name is unique across the collection — one shared tag identity per name … (no duplicate tags with the same name)."

The checklist records this third revision and still passes with no open clarifications.

### 👉 At this gate

This was your "one last detail." If it reads right, **approve** and I'll move to `speckit-plan` — the implementation plan, which I'll bring back for its own approval before any code is written. If anything's still off, tell me and I'll revise.
